touches.text: Seals: one current validation per proof, beside the proof. A seal holds while the code it measured is unchanged.
A timed-out run is its own outcome, not red.
Test tiers: commit, hourly, daily and weekly. Each tier runs only what it must, so a commit needs only its own proofs and the long runs wait for the long tiers; nothing runs just in case.

Commit: the proofs of the component the ticket changed, since RULE 1 bounds a change to its component. Passing them puts the component in service, yellow: proven where it changed, not yet measured against what depends on it. In service needs only the best we can do now: 80% trust.
